name: Gangtok, Darjeeling, East, South and West Sikkim trip
route: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra S → Exploring the Charms of Pelling → Gangtok → EAST SIKKIM trip → Nathang VALLEY sight seeing and back → Gangtok → Darjeeling → TIGER HILL and OTHER

itinerary.title: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra S
itinerary.desc: we provide direct pickup from RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS To Ravangla. Visit the Buddha Park | Tallest Buddha Statue in Sikkim) Explore Ravangla town and visit the Terni Tea Garden, the only Tea Estate in Sikkim. Stay in Ravangla

itinerary.title: Explore Ravangla and Peiling drop
itinerary.desc: Visit Raiong Monastery Titanic View point and reach Pelling through magical views enroute Overnight stay in Pelling "West Sikkim is written in mist and mountains."

itinerary.title: Exploring the Charms of Pelling
itinerary.desc: Visit the Pelling Skywalk at Chenrezig Statue, the historic Rabdentse Ruins Explore nearby spots like Tashiding Monastery, Changey Waterfalls, or Rabdentse Bird Park. Drop to Gangtok hotel after Pelling sight seeing "Every turn in Gangtok feels like a postcard."

itinerary.title: Local sight seeing in Gangtok
itinerary.desc: includes 7 points in and around Gangtok Experience Ropeway of Gangtok Tashi view point Hanuman Tok & Ganesh Tok Bulbulay Falis (enjoy Zipline adventure) Enchey Monastery Himalayan Zoological Park Stay in Gangtok "In East Sikkim, even the clouds seem to pause and admire the view

itinerary.title: Gangtok to EAST SIKKIM trip
itinerary.desc: Visit the magical Tsomgo lake, Experience highest ropeway in Asia (14,000 ft) Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir Stay in Nathang Valley (Valley facing stay)

itinerary.title: Nathang VALLEY sight seeing and back to Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Silk Route (ZULUK) Thambi view point (panoramic view of MT Kanchenjunga) Old Baba Harbhajan Singh Temple Back to Gangtok "Darjeeling feels like breathing deeper."

itinerary.title: Reach Darjeeling
itinerary.desc: Enjoy local cafes and food Darjeeling town. Check into the hotel. Go for Toy Train Ride and evening will be for leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling

itinerary.title: TIGER HILL and OTHER LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.desc: Start your day early morning at 3 am. First point, will be the Tiger Hill and then we will visit the Batasia Loop & the Tea Garden. Visit Local sightseeing like Ghoom Monastery, Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Peace Pagoda. Darjeeling to N.JP/Bagdogra/Siliguri we provide exact drop to RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS Drop to Bagdogra/NJP

inclusions: Accommodation in double & triple sharing (Deluxe rooms)
exclusions: Any kind of activity charges and entry fees
